sloka: अत्येति रजनी या तु सा न प्रतिनिवर्त्तते ।यात्येव यमुना पूर्णा समुद्रमुदकाकुलम् ॥ २.१०५.१९॥
transliteration: atyeti rajanī yā tu sā na pratinivarttate ।yātyeva yamunā pūrṇā samudramudakākulam ॥ 2.105.19॥

translations.english: A night that once passe off does not return like the waters of river Yamuna that flow into the ocean filled with water (the water do not flow back into Yamuna).
